questions.prompt: What does the name Big Ben refer to precisely?
questions.translation: Co přesně označuje Big Ben?
questions.explanation: Big Ben is the main bell inside Elizabeth Tower.
questions.explanation_cs: Big Ben je hlavní zvon uvnitř Elizabeth Tower.

questions.prompt: Which building contains Elizabeth Tower?
questions.translation: Ke které budově patří Elizabeth Tower?
questions.explanation: The tower forms part of the Palace of Westminster.
questions.explanation_cs: Věž je součástí Westminsterského paláce.

questions.prompt: The Clock Tower was renamed in 2012. Which occasion did this honour?
questions.translation: Jakou událost připomíná přejmenování v roce 2012?

options.text: The end of the Second World War

questions.explanation: The new name marked the Queen's Diamond Jubilee.
questions.explanation_cs: Nové jméno připomíná diamantové jubileum Alžběty II.

questions.prompt: You walk around Elizabeth Tower. How many clock faces can you see in total?
questions.translation: Kolik ciferníků má věž celkem?
questions.explanation: Its clock has a face on each of four sides.
questions.explanation_cs: Ciferník je na každé ze čtyř stran.

questions.prompt: Which description fits the London Eye?
questions.translation: Který popis odpovídá London Eye?
questions.explanation: The Eye is an observation wheel, 135 metres tall.
questions.explanation_cs: Jde o vyhlídkové kolo vysoké 135 metrů.

questions.prompt: Allow about half an hour for one rotation. Approximately how long is that?
questions.translation: Kolik času přibližně vyhradit na jednu otáčku?
questions.explanation: A standard rotation takes about 30 minutes.
questions.explanation_cs: Běžná otáčka trvá přibližně 30 minut.

questions.prompt: The real Eye has more pods than this simplified game model. How many are in its design?
questions.translation: Kolik kabinek má skutečné kolo, na rozdíl od herní zkratky?
questions.explanation: The real wheel has 32 pods; the game is simplified.
questions.explanation_cs: Skutečné kolo má 32 kabinek; hra je zjednodušená.

questions.prompt: Unless you book a private pod, what should you expect?
questions.translation: Co očekávat bez objednání soukromé kabinky?

options.text: You may share with other visitors
Every group gets its own pod
You have to operate the wheel

questions.explanation: Regular pods may be shared with other guests.
questions.explanation_cs: Běžnou kabinku mohou sdílet další návštěvníci.

questions.prompt: On which bank of the Thames is the London Eye?
questions.translation: Na kterém břehu Temže je London Eye?
questions.explanation: The Eye stands on the South Bank.
questions.explanation_cs: Kolo stojí na jižním břehu.

questions.prompt: Which river separates the Eye from the Houses of Parliament?
questions.translation: Která řeka odděluje kolo od parlamentu?
questions.explanation: The Thames runs between these landmarks.
questions.explanation_cs: Mezi těmito památkami protéká Temže.

questions.prompt: You arrive at Waterloo and want to walk to the Eye. Which signs should you follow?
questions.translation: Které značení sledovat z Waterloo ke kolu?
questions.explanation: The Eye's directions tell Waterloo visitors to follow South Bank signs.
questions.explanation_cs: Oficiální trasa vede podle značek South Bank.

questions.prompt: A friend asks where to find the Eye's ticket office. Which neighbouring building should you name?
questions.translation: Ve které sousední budově je pokladna?
questions.explanation: The ticket office is inside County Hall next to the Eye.
questions.explanation_cs: Pokladna sídlí v sousední County Hall.

questions.prompt: Tower Bridge and London Bridge appear separately on a map. What should you conclude?
questions.translation: Co vyvodit ze dvou názvů mostů na mapě?

options.text: They are names for the same bridge

questions.explanation: The bridge authority maintains them as separate Thames crossings.
questions.explanation_cs: Správce uvádí dva samostatné mosty přes Temži.

questions.prompt: Tower Bridge's central road sections rise. Why is this useful?
questions.translation: Proč se zvedají střední části Tower Bridge?

options.text: To turn the road into a railway

questions.explanation: Its bascules lift to allow river traffic through.
questions.explanation_cs: Zvedací části umožňují průjezd lodí.

questions.prompt: Tower Bridge opened in 1894. Which period does that place its opening in?
questions.translation: Do kterého století patří otevření roku 1894?
questions.explanation: 1894 falls in the nineteenth century.
questions.explanation_cs: Rok 1894 patří do devatenáctého století.

questions.prompt: On the Tube you touch in with your phone. How should you touch out?
questions.translation: Přiložíš při vstupu do metra telefon. Čím se odbavit na výstupu?
questions.explanation: Use the same card or device at both ends of a Tube journey.
questions.explanation_cs: Na obou koncích cesty metrem použij stejné zařízení.

questions.prompt: You board a London bus using pay as you go. What is the correct touching procedure?
questions.translation: Jak se odbavit v londýnském autobusu při pay as you go?
questions.explanation: Buses require a touch in, without a touch out.
questions.explanation_cs: V autobuse se přikládá jen při nástupu.

questions.prompt: You want to pay only for the journeys you make. Which option describes this?
questions.translation: Jak se nazývá platba za skutečně uskutečněné cesty?
questions.explanation: Pay as you go uses contactless or Oyster for journeys taken.
questions.explanation_cs: Pay as you go využívá bezkontaktní platbu nebo Oyster.

questions.prompt: You are meeting at the National Gallery. Which square should you head for?
questions.translation: Na které náměstí zamířit k National Gallery?
questions.explanation: The National Gallery faces Trafalgar Square.
questions.explanation_cs: National Gallery stojí na Trafalgar Square.

questions.prompt: A notice says: general admission is free; some exhibitions have a charge. What does this mean?
questions.translation: Co znamená bezplatný běžný vstup a placené některé výstavy?

options.text: Some special exhibitions may cost extra
You must pay for every room
Only staff may enter for free

questions.explanation: Free general entry does not include every temporary exhibition.
questions.explanation_cs: Běžný vstup zdarma nezahrnuje každou dočasnou výstavu.
